examples.en: The new posts were only advertised internally.
examples.zh: 新职位仅限于内部招聘。

examples.en: Half of the posts will be lost through natural wastage.

examples.en: O'Leary served in federal energy posts in both the Ford and Carter administrations.
examples.zh: 奥利里在福特政府和卡特政府期间都任过联邦政府能源部门的职位。
